shared_elements: large central disc/circular motif on the main field
concentric circles / ring of small circular elements
carved relief on an upright slab or standing monument
bands of pattern framing or crossing the field
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing a prominent circular/disc motif surrounded by smaller circles or curvilinear ornament, with framing bands of repeating pattern. But A depicts an anthropomorphic figure — a head, shoulders, arms/breasts and body with discs on the torso — and no animals, whereas B is a purely ornamental field dominated by a whirling multi-armed rosette flanked by four quadrupeds in profile, a scheme absent from A.
